Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
If :ctrl_block_1.attrib_group is not null then 
 
 begin
 select code_desc into :ctrl_block_1.group_desc
 from master_codes
 where code = :ctrl_block_1.attrib_group and
 code_type = 'ATTR' and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('5000');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 
 begin
 select old_attrib_group into :ctrl_block_1.old_group from valid_attributes where
 attrib_group=:ctrl_block_1.attrib_group and rownum=1;
 exception when others then
 null;
 end;
 
--
go_block('attributes');
clear_block;
:system.message_level := '10';
execute_query;
:system.message_level := '0';
Else
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.old_group');

End If;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
nullchk;
check_package_failure;
--
-- Check that effective date is >= today
--
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT')
 then
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(sysdate)
 then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 IF :term_date is not null and
 trunc(:eff_date) > trunc(:term_date)
 THEN
 show_error('8045');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 end if;
end;
